verdict.rationale: Unity documents automation building blocks: command-line arguments to 'automate workflows', headless mode, a CLI for CI pipelines, and Build Automation with continuous integration features. None of the evidence documents a way to schedule recurring jobs, such as timed or cron-style builds. Running Unity from an external CI scheduler is a user-side workaround, and one-off automation is not a recurring schedule, so the applicable axis has no evidenced support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
